diagnosis: The application VAPID configuration endpoint overwrites the WebPush VAPID keypair for the specified appId with client-supplied values. It lacks an ownership check confirming that the authenticated developer owns the application. An attacker can overwrite the VAPID keys of a rival application, permanently breaking push notification delivery for all its active browser and mobile subscribers.

PUT /api/apps/app_popular_social_network/vapid-settings HTTP/1.1
Host: pushgateway.io:8102
Authorization: Bearer <developer_token_mallory>
